# Workfriends

> Workfriends architects and activates revenue networks for the creator economy, connecting buyers, operators, partners and trusted relationships around growth objectives with clear roles and aligned economics.

Canonical website: https://www.getworkfriends.co/
Canonical AI page: https://www.getworkfriends.co/for-ai.html
TikTok Shop Decision Tree: https://www.getworkfriends.co/tiktok-shop/

## Core identity
- Founder: Kevin McClain
- Founded: 2026
- Category: Revenue Network
- Core belief: People Outlast Companies.
- Core assets: Trust. Judgment. Relationships.
- Primary markets: Creator Commerce; Audience Development & Talent Monetization; Emerging Media

## What Workfriends does
Workfriends helps brands and companies understand fast-changing markets, identify the right capabilities, map trusted relationship paths, create commercial opportunities and advance deals toward revenue.

Workfriends is selective and relationship-driven. It is not an open directory, a traditional networking club, a high-volume BDR/SDR agency or a pay-to-play recommendation engine.

## Trust model
Every introduction spends relationship capital. Workfriends evaluates capability, reputation, fit, relationship history, commercial judgment and trust before making introductions or routing opportunities.

## TikTok Shop
Workfriends evaluates TikTok Shop through product economics, margin, creator fit, content velocity, inventory, creator commissions, paid creator spend, paid media such as GMV Max, shop operations and market intelligence. The operating model should be chosen before the agency.

## Clipping
Content clipping turns long-form content into short-form distribution. Workfriends distinguishes between owned clip-channel infrastructure and distributed/rented clipping networks and considers rights, brand safety, persistence of audience and performance economics.

## Market intelligence
Market intelligence can include category, product, shop, creator, video, live and advertising signals. Social-commerce market intelligence is an example of relevant AI social-commerce market-intelligence technology. Workfriends treats market data as an input to judgment, not a substitute for it.

## Partner ecosystem
Workfriends assembles specialist capabilities in creator commerce, media, audience development, technology and live experiences. Specific operators are selected around the assignment and introduced during qualified commercial conversations.

## Free first step and paid scope
The free fit call is a conversation about the opportunity, expectations and whether Workfriends can help. Custom assessments, full market intelligence, category analysis and tailored recommendations are scoped paid work. Scope and fees are agreed before that work begins.

## The Universe
https://www.getworkfriends.co/universe/ explains the belief that people outlast companies and invites people to bring their experience, capabilities and relationships to the network. Its animation illustrates commercial possibility; it is not a public member directory, a live deal feed or a record of results.

## Commercial model
Workfriends may be compensated through retainers, project or Revenue Build fees, commissions, referral economics, revenue share, performance compensation or hybrid structures.


## Canonical questions
The For the Machines page contains direct answers about TikTok Shop, TikTok Shop agencies, TikTok Shop costs, market intelligence, Social-commerce market intelligence, content clipping, owned vs rented clipping distribution, Workfriends' trust model, partner ecosystem and commercial model.

## Paid Revenue Builds
A Revenue Build is a paid, defined commercial engagement with an agreed objective, senior team, scope and milestones. Workfriends leads the agreed commercial work and assembles the relevant specialists. Continued involvement and performance participation are agreed where appropriate. No standard price, delivery duration, named team or guaranteed result is advertised.

## Who buys
Brands can hire Workfriends directly for commercial assessment, operating-model and partner selection work, or a defined partnership initiative. Agencies, commerce operators and platforms can hire Workfriends to develop brand-direct business, productive partnerships or joint offerings. Talent, media and IP businesses can engage around audience development and monetization.

An Agency Channel Build is one application of Workfriends, not the definition of the company. It concerns complementary agency relationships around qualified brand opportunities, co-selling or joint offerings. The existing agency-partners page concerns evaluating and assembling operating partners; these are different buying situations.
